overview:
Connecticut's 2nd District leans Democratic, and longtime incumbent Joe Courtney is seeking another term. He has out-raised Republican George Austin roughly three to one and holds a large cash-on-hand advantage, with only minimal outside spending on either side. No public general-election polls are available, and no expert raters have listed the race, so the picture rests on fundamentals and market pricing.

Prediction markets put Courtney's chances around 94%, and the district's fundamentals point to a comfortable but not overwhelming Democratic margin. Austin has run a low-profile campaign with modest resources, and there are no signs of a competitive race developing. The seat rates as Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty coming from the absence of polling rather than any specific evidence of a serious challenge.
